caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate pitcher placed centrally on a plain, lightly textured background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of gray, using graphite or pencil, with careful shading to convey its metallic surface and three-dimensional form. The body of the pitcher is bulbous with a narrow neck that flares slightly at the rim. The base is round and tiered, suggesting a sturdy support. Attached to the right side of the pitcher is an elaborate handle with decorative scrollwork and curves, also shaded to indicate its metallic nature. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the artist’s signature and the date "1931" are visible. The overall composition is minimal, focusing solely on the central object without any additional items or background elements.
title: Silver Pitcher
